mechanism: Esomeprazole may inhibit metabolism of phenelzine and increase serotonergic activity, while phenelzine is a non-selective MAOI with potential for hypertensive crisis and serotonin syndrome when combined with agents affecting serotonin or metabolism.
action: Avoid concurrent use; if clinically necessary, use extreme caution with close blood pressure monitoring, patient education on dietary tyramine restriction, and consideration of alternative antidepressants or gastroprotective agents.
